name: Dayo Messerschmidt
creator: Dayo Messerschmidt
description: Operating out of a reclaimed machine space in the deep Tier 1 corridor known as the Wick, Messerschmidt has published over two hundred issues of the zine 'Floordust' since 2201 — irregular, handprinted on salvaged substrates, distributed through a network of trusted hands that has never been fully mapped by authorities. Each issue collects writing, drawing, and documentation from the Gray Zone residents with no editorial filter beyond Messerschmidt's selection. She writes under her own name only occasionally; mostly she curates and prints.
medium: physical print on salvaged substrate — no digital version exists
cultural_impact: 'Floordust' is considered the most authentic ongoing document of Tier 1 life in existence. Copies that reach Tier 3-4 academics are treated as primary sources. Messerschmidt refuses all interviews conducted outside the Wick.
controversy: A Tier 4 academic press offered to produce a retrospective anthology of 'Floordust' content in 2218. Messerschmidt's rejection was printed as the entirety of 'Floordust' issue 187. Corporate cultural monitors have attempted twice to locate her print operation and been misdirected both times by the Wick community.
story_hooks: A contributor to 'Floordust' has gone missing shortly after their piece — about witnessing a corponation disposal operation — appeared in print.
Someone is producing counterfeit 'Floordust' issues with fabricated content designed to discredit the real publication, and Messerschmidt needs help tracing the source.
A Tier 5 collector is offering an obscene sum for a complete run of all 200+ issues — and the offer feels like more than collecting.
